name: Postmark
tagline: Transactional email API for reliable delivery and tracking
description: Postmark is a transactional email delivery API for sending, tracking, and managing application email. Developers use server API tokens to send messages, manage templates, bounce handling, and inbound processing with JSON over HTTPS.

auth.details: Server API token via X-Postmark-Server-Token header (or account token for account-level endpoints); self-serve signup.

example.request: curl "https://api.postmarkapp.com/email" -X POST -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Postmark-Server-Token: YOUR_API_KEY" -d '{"From":"sender@example.com","To":"receiver@example.com","Subject":"Hello","TextBody":"Hello from Postmark"}'

use_cases: send transactional email from an app
check delivery and bounce status for a message
